notes:
West Virginia's recurring entity-level levy on an LLC is the Business Registration Tax of W. Va. Code § 11-12-3: no person may engage in any business activity in the state without an annual business registration certificate from the Tax Commissioner, and the tax is a flat $30 per certificate (per business location). It passes the inclusion test as the state's own annual condition for doing business - the Delaware 'annual tax' shape under another label. The exemptions do not change the ordinary case: a person with gross business income of $4,000 or less in the prior tax year who is not required to collect or withhold a tax and does not claim a sales-tax exemption is exempt from both registration and payment; a person required to register who had gross income of $10,000 or less is exempt from the tax but must still hold the certificate; 501(c) organizations are exempt from payment. firstYearExemption is false: there is no first-year waiver, and the exemptions are annual-income classes, not entity-age rules. dueDate is null: the statute sets no fixed calendar date - the tax accompanies the annual certificate - and the State Tax Department's own site does not answer from this network to add one.
The tax literally named 'Business Franchise Tax' (article 23 of chapter 11) is the trap this record exists to catch: a copied table would record it as West Virginia's levy, but § 11-23-6(b)(11) says 'For taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2015, there shall be no tax due under the provisions of this article.' Its subject class was corporations and partnerships, and the article is now a zero-liability shell. The general Business and Occupation Tax rates were repealed in 1989 (§ 11-13-2a, -2b); the B&O sections that remain are utility and power-industry rates, not an ordinary LLC's. The corporate license tax (article 12C) and the corporation net income tax (article 24) are corporation-only.
collectedWithAnnualReport is false: root states.json carries annual_report_fee 25 for West Virginia, the Secretary of State's annual report fee, a separate payment with no tax to overlap.
stateIncomeTax: members owe West Virginia personal income tax on their pass-through shares - § 11-21-3(b) taxes owners only in their separate or individual capacities unless the entity elects otherwise. The top marginal rate is 4.58% for taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2026 (§ 11-21-4j; the 2025 rate was 4.82% under § 11-21-4i). West Virginia offers the elective pass-through entity tax of § 11-21-3a: a pass-through entity that is not a disregarded entity may elect, annually and irrevocably for the year, to pay a tax equal to the top individual marginal rate at the entity level, with owners receiving a credit (an IRS Notice 2020-75 design).
needsReview: The State Tax Department's own site (tax.wv.gov) did not answer on the VPN-up route on 2026-08-07 (TCP timeouts on three tries), so this record is statute-only - the Ohio model. The code carries every recorded value; an agency page would only corroborate the current administration of the business registration certificate and its $30 fee.
